entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I need to process a return for an Urban Commuter Helmet I purchased a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a matter of preference. The color just wasn't what my partner was hoping for. It's been sitting in the closet, and the box is still unopened.

I understand completely. Getting the right color is important, and we definitely want you to be happy with your gear. Your safety is our top priority, and that includes being comfortable with what you're wearing. Let me just pull up your order. I see it was delivered 76 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. We just kept forgetting to deal with it.

No problem at all. Let me check the policy here... Okay, great news. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at 76 days, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and authorize this return for a full refund.

That's fantastic. I appreciate you making that simple. Now, since I do have to go through the process of shipping it back, and I'll likely be buying another helmet from you, would it be possible to get a small 10% discount code for my next order?

I'm glad we could get the full refund approved for you. While I'm not able to add a discount code on top of the refund, I can assure you the return shipping is prepaid, so there will be no cost to you to send the helmet back to us.
Okay, that's fair. A full refund and free shipping is a good outcome. I just figured it couldn't hurt to ask. What's the next step?

Of course. I've just sent a return authorization and a prepaid shipping label to the email on your account. Just print out the label, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any local courier. Once our warehouse scans it in, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
